steps.text: Wash and properly dry the ripest strawberries and chill.
Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping.
Open a very cold bottle of alcohol-free sparkling wine alongside.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley, finely chopped shallot and a splash of verjuice.
Put the escargot in a baking dish and cover each one with the butter.
Bake at 200C until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

Business dinner eye fillet and red wine.n: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus
Business dinner eye fillet and red wine.make_ahead: Bake the gratin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear the fillet, reduce the grape juice jus and steam the beans on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and prepare the shallots and beans.
Layer the potatoes with the cream, crushed garlic and salt, and bake at 160C.
Sear the eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 200C to 54C inside.
Rest the beef. Chop the shallots and soften in the pan.
Add the grape juice and balsamic and reduce by half, then add the stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in some of the butter.
Steam the beans and toss with the remaining butter.

Penthouse champagne cocktail.make_ahead: Chill the bottle in the fridge up to 1 day ahead and brew and cool the tea up to 1 day ahead; build the drinks to order

steps.text: Chill the bottle in an ice bucket. Brew the tea strong and let it cool.
Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes and soak with a teaspoon of the tea and a drop of vanilla.
Add the apple juice, then slowly top with the alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

Bootleg lager.make_ahead: Chill the bottles at least 3 hours ahead

steps.text: Chill the bottles of alcohol-free lager in the fridge for at least 3 hours, then keep them cold in a tub of ice.
Pour the alcohol-free lager into heavy glass steins straight down the middle so each gets a proper head.

Canadian rye.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Steep the tea leaves in the hot water for 5 minutes, strain and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Cool in the fridge until cold.
Put one large ice cube in each of 4 short glasses.
Pour 60ml of the cold tea over the ice in each glass and serve.

Repeal Day old fashioned.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, tea up to 1 day

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in 40ml of the hot water to make syrup.
Steep the tea in the rest of the hot water for 4 minutes, strain and chill until cold.
For each drink, stir 60ml tea, a little syrup, a drop of vanilla and a squeezed strip of orange zest over ice for 30 seconds and strain over a large cube.
Twist a fresh strip of orange peel over the top.

Christmas fruit cake slices.make_ahead: Soak the fruit in the orange juice overnight in the fridge, up to 1 day ahead; the baked cake keeps up to 1 week, wrapped

steps.text: Soak the fruit in the orange juice overnight.
Cream the butter and sugar and beat in the eggs.
Fold in the fruit, flour, spice and almonds.
Bake in a lined tin at 150C.
Cool and slice thin.

Willie's bourbon and ginger highball.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, stir in the brown sugar and vanilla, then cool in the fridge.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice.
Add the cold tea and lime juice to each.
Top with ginger beer and stir once.
Add a lime wedge and a cinnamon stick.

Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus.n: Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus
Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat; make the grape juice jus up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; sear and rest the steaks on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Reduce the grape juice and balsamic with the stock into a jus.
Sear the steaks hard.
Rest and slice the steaks.
Steam the green beans.
Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

Deckard's Scotch and honey highball.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Steep the tea leaves in the boiling water for 4 minutes, strain and chill until cold.
Stir the honey into the hot water to loosen and cool.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add the smoky tea, honey syrup and lemon juice, then stir.
Top each with ginger ale and stir once more.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.

Lager battered onion rings.make_ahead: Soak the onions in the buttermilk up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; whisk the batter with the cold alcohol-free lager and fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.
Whisk the flour with the cold alcohol-free lager into a batter.
Heat the oil to 185C. Dip the rings in the batter and fry in batches until puffed and golden.
Salt and serve hot.

Mass quantities lager shandy jug.make_ahead: Chill the alcohol-free lager and lemonade up to 1 day ahead; add the ice and citrus and pour just before serving

steps.text: Chill the alcohol-free lager and lemonade until very cold.
Fill a large jug with ice and add the lemon and lime wedges, squeezing as they go in.
Pour in the alcohol-free lager and lemonade together, slowly. Stir once and pour into big glasses.

Forty-clove garlic chicken.make_ahead: Brown the chicken and assemble the pan up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the chicken skin side down in oil
Add the garlic, thyme, stock and verjuice
Cover and bake at 180C
Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of the Italian loaf and eat with the chicken

Holy water lemon, lime and bitters.n: Holy water lemon, lime and bitters (alcohol-free)
Holy water lemon, lime and bitters.make_ahead: Steep and cool the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; squeeze the citrus on the day and top with lemonade to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bag and cloves in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard them and cool the spiced tea.
Squeeze the limes and lemon, keeping a few lime wedges.
Fill glasses with crushed ice.
Add lime juice, lemon juice, a splash of the spiced tea and the pomegranate syrup to each.
Top with cold lemonade, stir once and drop in a lime wedge. For the bottle look, mix it all in a jug and pour into small glass bottles before serving over ice.

Chicken piccata.make_ahead: Pound the chicken thin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; sear and make the stock sauce on the night

steps.text: Pound the chicken thin, cut in half, then flour.
Boil the pasta until tender and drain.
Sear the chicken in oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the stock, lemon juice and capers and reduce.
Whisk in the butter. Toss the pasta through and serve the chicken on top.

Date doctor French 75.make_ahead: Chill the flutes and juice the lemon up to 1 day ahead; shake the non-alcoholic gin mix and top with the sparkling wine to order

steps.text: Chill the flutes.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.
Strain into the flutes and top with the alcohol-free sparkling wine, pouring slowly.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.
Brew the coffee, stir in the brown sugar and vanilla and cool.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar, then fold in the mascarpone and whipped cream.
Dip the savoiardi quickly and layer with the cream in a dish.
Set overnight in the fridge.
Sift cocoa on top.

Negroni.make_ahead: Mix the grape juice and balsamic up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir over ice to order

steps.text: Mix the grape juice with the balsamic.
Stir the non-alcoholic gin, aperitif and grape mix over ice for 20 seconds, one drink at a time.
Strain over a big cube and twist orange peel over the top.

ingredients.item: rib eye steak, in four pieces

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry the frites in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Pat the steaks dry and season. Sear in a heavy pan on both sides, then rest.
Add the cracked black peppercorns and Worcestershire to the pan, then the stock, and reduce.
Add the cream and simmer. Serve the steaks with the sauce and frites.
Brew a small cup of strong black tea and cool it in the fridge.

Put a sugar cube in each flute and soak with a teaspoon of the tea and a drop of vanilla. Add the apple juice, top slowly with the chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine and twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.
Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, stock, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry in the vegetable oil at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.

Japanese whisky highball.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the barley tea in the boiling water for 5 minutes, stir in the honey and chill until very cold.
Pack four tall glasses with ice.
Add 120ml of the cold tea to each and top with very cold soda water.
Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.

Creamy tarragon chicken.make_ahead: Cook the chicken in its stock, verjuice and cream sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and reheat gently; mash the potatoes and steam the beans fresh

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, slice the mushrooms and chop the tarragon.
Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the stock and verjuice and simmer.
Stir in the cream and tarragon.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and steam the beans.

Spilled orange juice mimosas.make_ahead: Squeeze and strain the orange juice up to 1 day ahead and chill it with the alcohol-free sparkling wine; pour to order

steps.text: Squeeze the oranges and strain the juice.
Chill the juice and the alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Pour orange juice into each of four flutes, then slowly top with the alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each and hang on the rim.

Christmas pudding.make_ahead: Soak the dried fruit in the orange juice the night before; the steamed pudding keeps up to 2 weeks wrapped, steam to reheat

steps.text: Soak the dried fruit in the orange juice overnight.
Beat the butter and sugar, beat in the eggs, then mix in the breadcrumbs, flour, spice and the soaked fruit.
Pack into a greased pudding basin, cover and steam.
Turn out onto a plate, scatter with the orange zest and serve with warm custard.
Separate the eggs and whisk the yolks with the sugar. Keep the whites for another use.
Heat the milk and cream, pour over the yolks and stir over low heat to 75C.
Chill well.
Stir in the vanilla and cinnamon and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

Peach brandy bread pudding.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Soak the peaches in the orange juice and brown sugar.
Butter the bread and layer with the peaches in a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and vanilla and pour over.
Rest so the bread soaks up the custard.
Bake at 170C until set and golden. Serve warm.
Brew the coffee strong using the water.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick.
Put brown sugar, peach nectar and a drop of vanilla into 4 diner mugs, pour in hot coffee and stir. Spoon a little cream on top and serve straight away.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry well. Whisk the batter flour, cornflour and cold alcohol-free lager together.
Fry the chips in oil at 140C until pale and soft, then drain.
Cook the peas, then crush with the butter and chopped mint and keep warm.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Salt well and serve with the fish, peas and malt vinegar.

Costigan's cranberry lime crush.make_ahead: Mix the base up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the limes and orange.
Shake the cranberry juice, lime juice, orange juice and syrup with ice, then strain into 4 short glasses of crushed ice. Top with soda and a lime wedge.

Mr Hunham's flaming cherries jubilee.make_ahead: Make the cherry sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; reheat, stir in the vanilla and serve over ice cream

steps.text: Drain the cherries, keeping some of the syrup.
Melt the butter with the sugar in a wide pan, add the syrup and the orange zest and juice and simmer.
Stir in the cornflour mixed with water, then add the cherries and warm through.
Off the heat, stir in the vanilla and let the sauce settle for a minute.
Spoon over scoops of ice cream.

Mr Hunham's bourbon hot toddy.make_ahead: Best made fresh in the mug; stud the lemon slices with cloves up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Boil water in a kettle.
Steep a tea bag in each heatproof mug of boiling water for 3 minutes, then remove.
Stir in honey, lemon juice, a drop of vanilla and a cinnamon stick until the honey dissolves.
Stud a lemon slice with cloves and float it on top.

Chorizo, Manchego and quince tapas.make_ahead: Slice the chorizo and cut the Manchego up to 1 day ahead, chilled; fry the chorizo and warm the olives on the night

steps.text: Slice the chorizo and fry until crisp.
Add the grape juice and balsamic and cook until sticky.
Cut the Manchego into triangles and top each with a sliver of quince paste.
Warm the olives with strips of orange peel.
Serve everything on small plates.

Elena's flamenco sangria.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled, add soda just before serving

steps.text: Brew the tea strong and let it cool.
Slice the oranges and apple into a large jug.
Pour in the grape juice, cold tea, orange juice and cinnamon stick.
Chill for 2 hours so the fruit soaks it up.
Top with cold soda water just before pouring into glasses over ice.

Molly Brown's first class filet mignon.n: Molly Brown's first class filet mignon
Molly Brown's first class filet mignon.make_ahead: Layer and bake the pommes Anna up to 1 day ahead and reheat; sear the steaks and reduce the sauce on the night

steps.text: Layer the potatoes with melted butter in a pan, season and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna.
Tie the steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C.
Reduce the shallots, grape juice, balsamic and stock to a sauce in the steak pan.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

Black velvet, stout and sparkling wine.n: Black velvet, stout and sparkling wine (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Half fill four tall glasses with the alcohol-free stout, poured slowly so it settles.
Top each slowly with the alcohol-free sparkling wine poured over the back of a spoon so it sits on top. Serve straight away.

Lightstone prime rib with horseradish.make_ahead: Rub the beef up to 1 day ahead and keep it uncovered in the fridge; mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Rub the beef with the garlic, pepper, oil and salt.
Roast at 220C, then lower to 180C for medium rare.
Rest the beef.
Parboil the potatoes, rough up, toss in duck fat and roast.
Simmer the pan juices with the grape juice, balsamic and stock until reduced by half.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.

Santa's stout and whisky boilermaker.make_ahead: Smoky tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Steep the tea leaves in the boiling water for 4 minutes, strain, stir in the maple syrup and chill.
Chill the pint glasses.
Pour the alcohol-free stout into each glass at an angle, then straighten up to build a creamy head. Let it settle before topping up.
Pour a measure of the cold smoky tea into shot glasses and serve alongside.

Hellfire Club pepper steak.make_ahead: Parboil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and chill; roast them, sear the steaks and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Parboil the potatoes, then shake to rough up.
Roast in hot oil at 220C until crisp.
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan, basting with butter for the last minute.
Rest the steaks.
In the same pan add the peppercorns and Worcestershire, then cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Slice and spoon the sauce over.

Sixties gin martini with olives.make_ahead: Put the martini glasses in the freezer up to 1 day ahead; stir the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice with ice and strain to order

steps.text: Put the martini glasses in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice, add the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice and stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the frozen glasses and add a toothpick with two olives to each.

Terminal Bar whiskey sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Shake the cold tea, lemon juice, the cooled syrup and egg white hard without ice, then again with ice.
Strain into 4 ice-filled rocks glasses. Dust each foam with a little cinnamon and add a cherry.

Leckie's lemon, lime and bitters.make_ahead: Brew and cool the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bag and cloves in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard them and cool the spiced tea.
Fill 4 pot glasses with ice.
Add the cordial, lemon juice, a splash of spiced tea and the pomegranate syrup to each.
Top with lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge.

Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch.n: Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch (alcohol-free)
Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch.make_ahead: Tea can be chilled a day ahead

steps.text: Brew the tea and chill.
Mix the tea with the molasses, vanilla, lime juice and sugar, stirring to dissolve.
Add plenty of ice and top with ginger beer.
Ladle into mugs with a lime wedge and mint.
Combine the grape juice, cold tea, sugar, orange, apple and cinnamon in a large jug. Stir to dissolve the sugar.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with lemonade. Pour into glasses with some of the fruit in each.

Ski lodge cheese fondue.make_ahead: Grate the cheeses and toss with the cornflour up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; cube the bread and apple and melt the fondue on the night

steps.text: Cube the baguette and apple and toss the gruyere and Swiss cheese with cornflour.
Rub a pot with the cut garlic clove.
Warm the apple juice and lemon juice, then stir in the cheese gradually until smooth.
Keep warm over low heat and dip in the baguette and apple.

Blood rave pomegranate sangria.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add ice at serving

steps.text: Mix the grape juice, cold tea, pomegranate juice, sugar and cinnamon in a big jug.
Add the oranges and pomegranate seeds.
Chill for at least two hours.
Add plenty of ice and top with soda water just before serving.

Hole-in-the-Wall bourbon sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Dry shake the cold tea, lemon juice, syrup and egg whites.
Add ice and shake hard.
Strain into glasses over ice.
Dust the foam with a little cinnamon and add a cherry.
Cut the oranges into small wedges.
For each drink, muddle 3 orange wedges, mint leaves and brown sugar syrup in a shaker.
Add 50ml cold tea, a drop of vanilla, lemon juice and ice and shake hard.
Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange wheel and a mint sprig.

Wooderson's \"alright, alright\" michela.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt for the rims up to 1 week ahead; build over ice and top with the cold alcohol-free lager to serve

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire to each.
Top slowly with the cold alcohol-free lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.

Same-guy-twice bourbon eggnog.make_ahead: Make the eggnog, stir in the vanilla and maple syrup and chill up to 2 days ahead; stir well, pour and grate the nutmeg to serve

steps.text: Whisk the yolks and sugar until pale.
Warm the milk, cream and nutmeg until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon, without boiling.
Cool, then stir in the vanilla and maple syrup.
Chill.
Pour into tumblers and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

Fight Man rematch lemon, lime and bitter.n: Fight Man rematch lemon, lime and bitters (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Steep the tea bag and cloves in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard them and cool the spiced tea.
Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Add lime cordial, a splash of spiced tea and the pomegranate syrup to each, top with lemonade and stir until it turns pink.
Garnish with lemon and lime wedges.

Coq au vin.make_ahead: Make the whole stew up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and reheat gently; mash the potatoes on the night

steps.text: Peel the onions and potatoes and slice the mushrooms.
Brown the chicken and lardons.
Add the onions and mushrooms, then the grape juice, balsamic, stock and thyme.
Simmer covered.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.

Family games night trifle.make_ahead: Best made the night before, keep chilled

steps.text: Put the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the orange juice.
Make up the jelly following the packet, pour it over the sponge and chill until set.
Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.
Top with the raspberries just before serving.

Emperors' spiced honey wine.make_ahead: Mix and warm up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat gently and strain into cups

steps.text: Pour the grape juice and tea into a saucepan with the honey, the cinnamon stick, the black peppercorns, the bay leaves and strips of orange peel.
Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves. Do not let it boil.
Strain into heavy cups.

Hancock's whisky sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the vanilla and chill.
For each drink, measure 50ml cold tea, the juice of 1 lemon, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white into a shaker.
Shake each drink without ice for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into a short glass over fresh ice.
Dust the foam with a little cinnamon.

Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù.n: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add both minces and brown hard.
Pour in the stock and balsamic and reduce, then add the tomatoes, parmesan rind and water.
Simmer gently, topping up with water.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the ragu with a splash of pasta water.
Grate the parmesan over.

Lab bench bourbon peach smash.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea and drain the peaches up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; muddle and shake to order

steps.text: Muddle half the peach slices with the syrup, lemon juice and mint leaves in a shaker.
Add the cold tea, vanilla and ice and shake hard.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice and garnish with a peach slice and a mint sprig.
Fill four tall glasses with crushed ice.
Into each pour the blue cordial and lime juice, then top with chilled lemonade and stir gently.
Squeeze the orange zest over the glasses for aroma, then garnish each with a lime wheel.

Arthur's whisky ginger highball.make_ahead: Syrup and tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain.
Steep the tea leaves in the boiling water for 4 minutes, strain and chill.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add the smoky tea, ginger syrup and lime juice to each.
Top with ginger ale, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Brew the coffee. Stir the sugar into each cup until dissolved.
Add a few drops of vanilla to each cup.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick and pour it gently over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.

Guzzoline dark and stormy.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice.
Squeeze lime juice into each and add the ginger beer.
Pour the dark tea slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats dark on top.
Add a lime wedge and serve unstirred.

Black suit espresso martini.make_ahead: Make the vanilla syrup up to 1 week ahead and the cold brew up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; shake to order

steps.text: Chill four martini glasses in the freezer.
Stir the vanilla into the sugar syrup.
Shake two drinks at a time with cold brew, vanilla syrup and plenty of ice, very hard for 30 seconds to build the foam.
Strain into the glasses and float three coffee beans on the foam. Repeat.

Raspberry sparkler.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day, top with sparkling wine just before serving

steps.text: Crush most of the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice and push through a sieve.
Spoon a spoonful of purée into each of 4 flutes.
Slowly top with the cold alcohol-free sparkling wine and drop a whole raspberry in each.

Casino martini.make_ahead: Chill the glasses and the non-alcoholic gin in the fridge up to 1 day ahead; stir each drink fresh over ice

steps.text: Stir the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice over plenty of ice until very cold, one drink at a time.
Strain into chilled martini glasses and add a green olive on a pick.

ingredients.item: bottles Mexican style alcohol-free lager (330 ml each)

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice.
Into each glass add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top slowly with the cold alcohol-free lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge.

Fountain of Youth rum punch.make_ahead: Mix everything but the soda water up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled; add the soda water and ice to serve

steps.text: Juice the limes and cut the pineapple into wedges.
Mix the coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice, syrup and vanilla in a jug, then add the soda water.
Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour in the punch.
Grate nutmeg over the top and add a pineapple wedge.

Prizzi wedding white peach Bellini.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and stone the peaches, blend with the lemon juice and sugar until smooth.
Chill the purée for 30 minutes.
Spoon some purée into each chilled flute and top slowly with the alcohol-free sparkling wine poured down the side. Stir once and serve straight away.

Red Dog ruby grapefruit radler.make_ahead: Grapefruit soda up to 1 day, chilled

steps.text: Juice the grapefruit and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Mix with the soda water and chill well.
Half fill 4 tall glasses with the alcohol-free lager.
Top with the grapefruit soda and add a wedge.

Drago's Siberian cranberry vodka mule.make_ahead: Freeze the cranberry ice cubes overnight

steps.text: Freeze 180ml of the cranberry juice in an ice cube tray overnight.
Fill four mugs with crushed ice and the cranberry cubes, then add the rest of the cranberry juice, lime juice and a little grated ginger to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Drop in frozen cranberries and a rosemary sprig.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
In each tall glass, gently muddle mint with some syrup and lime juice.
Add the white grape juice, fill with crushed ice, top with soda and stir.

Eagles green apple shandy.make_ahead: Put the glasses in the freezer up to 1 hour ahead and keep the alcohol-free lager in the fridge; pour to order

ingredients.item: cans alcohol-free lager (375 ml each), cold

steps.text: Put 4 pint glasses in the freezer for the chilling time.
Juice the limes and slice the apple very thin.
Pour the alcohol-free lager into each glass, top with apple juice and a squeeze of lime, then float apple slices.

Lando's cape cocktail.make_ahead: Syrup and tea up to 1 week and 1 day, build fresh

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Stir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup.
For each drink, stir 60ml cold tea, the syrup and a squeezed strip of orange zest with ice, then strain over one big ice cube.
Twist a fresh strip of orange peel over the top.

Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spri.n: Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spritz (alcohol-free)
Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spri.make_ahead: Slice the strawberries and squeeze the lemon up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; add ice, alcohol-free rosé and soda water to order

steps.text: Slice the strawberries and divide between four large wine glasses.
Add elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each and press lightly.
Fill with ice, pour in the cold alcohol-free rosé and top with soda water.
Stir gently and add a lemon wheel.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa
Bake at 175C
Cool and split the cake
Brush with cherry syrup mixed with the vanilla
Whip the cream and layer with the cherries
Shave dark chocolate on top

Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour.n: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour (alcohol-free)

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Steep the smoky tea leaves in the boiling water for 4 minutes, strain and cool.
For each drink shake the black tea, lemon juice and syrup hard over ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler.
Float a teaspoon of the smoky tea on top and garnish with candied ginger.

Fredo's Havana daiquiri.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard the bags and chill.
Chill four coupes.
For each drink, shake 40ml green tea, 20ml grape juice, lime juice and syrup hard with plenty of ice, then double strain into a coupe.

Beorn's honey bourbon milk punch.make_ahead: Make the honey syrup up to 3 days ahead and keep it chilled; shake with the cold milk to order

steps.text: Warm the honey with the water until runny.
Cool the honey syrup.
Shake the first batch with ice: half the milk, honey, vanilla and cinnamon, then strain into two cups.
Repeat for the second batch.
Grate fresh nutmeg over the top.

Christmas Eve mulled wine.make_ahead: Brew the tea and mix it with the juices and spices up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; warm gently on the night

steps.text: Pour the grape juice and tea into a saucepan with the orange juice, honey, cinnamon sticks, star anise, cloves and orange slices.
Heat gently, keeping it below a simmer.
Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each.

Red lips cranberry cosmopolitan.make_ahead: Juice the limes and orange up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and chill the coupes; shake each drink with ice to order

steps.text: Chill four coupes.
Cut 4 strips of peel from the orange, then juice it.
For each drink, measure 50ml cranberry juice, 20ml white grape juice, 15ml orange juice and the juice of half a lime into a shaker.
Shake each drink with ice for 15 seconds and strain into the coupes.
Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in.

Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy.n: Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Thinly slice the ginger and juice the lemons, keeping a few wheels.
Steep a tea bag in each of 4 heatproof glasses of just-boiled water for 3 minutes, then remove.
Stir in honey, lemon juice and ginger slices until the honey dissolves. Add a lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick.

Never-empty mug of honey lager punch.n: Never-empty mug of honey lager punch (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Chill a large jug.
Mix the syrup, lemon juice and apple juice in the jug.
Slowly pour in the alcohol-free lager and stir gently once.
Pour into big mugs with a lemon wheel and keep a second jug ready.

Top End frozen mango daiquiri.make_ahead: Freeze the mango chunks up to 1 week ahead; blend with the coconut water, lime and syrup to serve

steps.text: Freeze the flesh of the ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours.
Mix the salt with a little chilli flakes, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.
Blend the frozen mango with the coconut water, the lime juice, the sugar syrup and the ice until thick and slushy.
Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel.

Cancún beach margarita.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard the bags and chill.
Juice the limes and orange and rim four glasses with salt.
Shake 40ml green tea, the orange juice, agave and lime juice hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses.

New Year's Eve champagne.make_ahead: Chill the bottle at least 3 hours ahead

steps.text: Chill the bottle of alcohol-free sparkling wine in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Sit the bottle in an ice bucket with the ice and a little cold water while you wait for midnight.
Open the bottle just before midnight and pour into four flutes.

Alkali Lake beef stew.make_ahead: Braise the stew up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; boil and mash the potatoes fresh

steps.text: Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Soften the vegetables, return the beef with the stock, balsamic and water to cover and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Cook the potatoes.
Spoon the stew over the mash.
